instruction: Find the page that contains contact details.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to contact/help page on Ticketek website. Similar difficulty to original task - simple navigation. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify URL contains contact/help/support keywords. No new functions needed - uses existing Chrome getters and metrics.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: user navigates to a contact information page
Getter (active_tab_info) correctly extracts the active tab URL from the browser
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly applies regex pattern matching to verify URL contains contact/help/support keywords
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL -> metric receives dict with 'url' field -> metric applies pattern matching
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (navigate to contact page)
No postconfig needed: this is a navigation task where final URL state is persistent
Expected value is semantically correct: the regex pattern 'contact|help|support' appropriately matches URLs containing contact information keywords
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor issue: regex pattern is case-sensitive. URL pattern 'contact|help|support' won't match 'Contact' or 'HELP'. Consider using case-insensitive flag (?i) for robustness: '(?i)contact|help|support'. However, this is a very minor issue since most URLs use lowercase paths.
